proposedMinimumVersionedRepair.activation: New prospectively frozen lifecycle plan/policy/schema only. Preserve the old dispatcher/defaults and archived raw/Q replay semantics. No retrospective application to either refused attempt.
streamingValidation: Add an explicit optional per-sample validator/accumulator to the new-version idle scheduler. Append the original unmodified observation to its declared log, validate raw evidence once before it may authorize progression, and maintain count/first/last/minAvailable/maxSwap/minSwap incrementally.

Remove the O(N) whole-phase verification loop from the live handoff of the new-version path. The independent auditor must still replay every original raw observation after execution; streaming is an execution optimization, not a replacement for independent scientific validation.

Keep sample collection start, observer start/finish, collection completion, validation start/finish, log-write completion and next scheduled deadline as separately captured actual monotonic values. A validation/write overrun, API UNKNOWN/FAIL or incomplete population stops; do not hide slow work by relabeling timestamps.

The new live accumulator must apply the unchanged memory/swap/process/API/empty-owned-root criteria and raw evidence verifier; no caching of mutable observations, derived PASS values or source-policy identity substitutions.
sharedScheduler: Use one persistent controller-owned scheduler/state machine through settling, admission, runtime activation and cleanup, rather than creating independent phase loops around an unobserved batch replay. The same monotonic clock, previous raw sample identity/time and pending adverse state survive every handoff.

Every phase has a real entry event, a fixed duration measured from that actual entry, nominal2s scheduled slots and a real exit event. Keep scheduled targets separately from actual observation/transition times. The shared scheduler may create the next phase local origin at the actual handoff event, but must not restart an adverse window, move a previous sample or declare a planned timestamp to have occurred.

For the600s and120s idle phases preserve declared300/60 slots at local0,2,...,598/118 and the full fixed end wait. Carry the previous sample across the phase-local origin change and require the actual next sample-start gap<=3s; the local slot index reset is a declared phase transition, not a new favorable admission attempt.

At the actual phase-exit event perform only constant-time accepted-state/coverage checks and switch the declared phase. No full-file read/replay, Git invocation, binary hash loop or large JSON serialization belongs between the final idle phases. Precreate required output handles/metadata before the fixed window; retain bounded per-sample durable writes and fail on budget overrun.

Do not disguise file I/O latency as continuity. If receipt serialization happens after handoff, the same owned sampler must already be observing the new phase and errors must stop progression. Any queue overflow, missing flush, missing observation or late deadline is a recorded refusal, not an invitation to skip/drop samples.

After admission acceptance arm the runtime guard and real controller ownership mode before child/renderer/DB launch or metadata work. Bind the exact runtime epoch and swap baseline to that actual event; continue observations during startup/cleanup and preserve one runtime resource timer history.

handoffRecords.meaning: All numeric event times must be captured where the event actually occurs. If one atomic phase switch is truly a single event, one captured timestamp can legitimately identify both exit and entry; it must not be manufactured by copying an earlier endpoint over later actual work.
